[{"step":1,"file":"freeradius-server/src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c","function":"fr_tacacs_decode","line":220,"var":"buffer","code":"fr_tacacs_decode(ctx, buffer, buffer_len, ..., secret, secret_len, cursor)","note":"Attacker-controlled TACACS+ packet bytes enter the decoder as the raw input buffer."},{"step":2,"file":"freeradius-server/src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c","function":"fr_tacacs_decode","line":516,"var":"pkt->author.req","code":"if (packet_is_author_request(pkt)) { ... if (tacacs_decode_args(ctx, cursor, attr_tacacs_argument_list, pkt->author.req.arg_cnt, BODY(author.req), &p, end) < 0) goto fail; }","note":"A crafted Authorization-Request packet reaches the argument parser, and its arg_cnt/arg_len fields control the subsequent copy sizes."},{"step":3,"file":"freeradius-server/src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c","function":"tacacs_decode_args","line":99,"var":"buffer[256]","code":"uint8_t buffer[256];","note":"The parser uses a fixed 256-byte stack buffer for each argument string."},{"step":4,"file":"freeradius-server/src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c","function":"tacacs_decode_args","line":109,"var":"buffer","code":"memcpy(buffer, p, arg_list[i]);","note":"An attacker-chosen argument length is copied into the fixed stack buffer without any upper bound check against 256 bytes."},{"step":5,"file":"freeradius-server/src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c","function":"tacacs_decode_args","line":110,"var":"buffer[arg_list[i]]","code":"buffer[arg_list[i]] = '\\0';","note":"The code then writes a terminator at the same unchecked index, so an oversized argument length causes a stack out-of-bounds write past buffer."}]
JSON
